title:
This utility will help run git utility commands on a local directory for given cloned repository in that directory.
 pass '--help' for `options` to get what possible options can be given to a particular command.
 Options can be
     ["--help"]
 if option requires a value pass it an next element in the list. e.g for checkout ["-b", "testbranch"]
